name: Sasha Antonovna Nikitina
original_name: サーシャ・アントーノヴナ・ニキーチナ
source: [spoiler]Tonya's little sister. She's used by a secret Russian military agency. Similarly to her older sister, she also have Kikimora transplanted, but she has two of them. She had to pay the price for this and lost her vision. That said, she's really proficient in using her Kikimoras, thus she has accomplished a way of using them as her eyesight. Due to the various surgeries, she only obeys the order of her "Father".[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]Tonya's little sister. She's used by a secret Russian military agency. Similarly to her older sister, she also have Kikimora transplanted, but she has two of them. She had to pay the price for this and lost her vision. That said, she's really proficient in using her Kikimoras, thus she has accomplished a way of using them as her eyesight. Due to the various surgeries, she only obeys the order of her "Father".[/spoiler]
